results.name: Context Token Cost

results.name: Prop Surface & Typing Precision
results.formula: 100 · (0.4·clamp(1 − max(0, props − 8)/12) + 0.6·precise/props); precise = boolean | number | enum/union | typed object/array | free string; a string validated with validateInRange or defaulted to an enum member is a stringly-typed enum (imprecise)
results.summary: 141 props, 95% precise; 7 stringly-typed enums, 0 unknown/untyped

results.name: Machine-Readable Schema Completeness
results.formula: mean over manifest entries of the mean of six facets (props typed, defaults, api, events, cssClasses, markup) · 100 · (entries / patterns); 0 without docs-ai/osui.components.json

results.name: Type Strictness
results.formula: 100 − min(40, 4·implicitAny/KLOC) − min(20, 10·explicitAny/KLOC) − min(10, 2.5·suppressions) − 30·(exported public functions without return type / total)
results.summary: 0 implicit-any findings, 0 explicit any, 0 ts-ignore/expect-error, 0/422 public fns without return type (41.2 KLOC)

results.name: Documentation Coverage
results.formula: 35·mean over API functions of (description, @param text per parameter, @returns text when it returns a value) + 15·(config props with a description) + 0.5·agentDocs; agentDocs = 20·llms.txt + 20·llms-components coverage + 20·llms-tokens.txt + 20·llms-patterns.txt + 20·llms-utilities.txt
results.summary: API facets 288.5/348 (172 functions complete), prop descriptions 141/141, agent docs 100/100

results.name: Public API Shape Consistency
results.formula: 100 · (0.4·canonical members present/7 + 0.3·non-lifecycle functions returning the CreateApiResponse envelope + 0.2·camelCase parameters + 0.1·no inline error-code literals)

results.name: Markup Contract Depth

results.name: Block Parameter Precision
results.criterion: Typed contracts at the block boundary
results.formula: per public block with parameters: 50·(params with a description) + 30·(optional params with a default; 1 when none is optional) + 20·(params whose type is not free Text or Object); mean over blocks
results.summary: 439/440 params described, 229/389 defaulted, 160 free-Text across 112 blocks

results.name: Block Card Cost and Recipes
results.criterion: Token budget of the block-level agent docs
results.formula: per public block: 70·band(card tokens, 250, 600) + 30·(OpenUI and TSX recipe lines present)/2; a block without a card scores 0; mean over blocks
results.summary: 0/118 blocks with a card; mean – tokens

results.name: Producer-Scoped Guidance
results.criterion: Agent documentation that separates OML composition from the runtime contract
results.formula: 20·(llms.txt has a Producers section naming llms-blocks.txt and llms-components.txt) + 20·(runtime-only gotchas marked [runtime-only], prorated) + 20·(pattern cards' Lifecycle and Markup lines marked, prorated) + 20·(llms-patterns.txt skeleton lines marked, prorated) + 20·(llms-blocks.txt exists and the index points at it)
results.summary: producers 0/20, gotchas 0/20, cards 0/20, patterns 0/20, blocksDoc 0/20
